title: The Porcupines’ Needle Holiday
description: On the first frosty evening, the porcupines bring their shed quills to the sewing table. The youngest spends the holiday stitching a red leaf.
alt: Three wool-felt porcupines gather around a sewing table. One stitches a red leaf, another holds a quill above a pumpkin pincushion, and the third offers a spool of gold thread.
pairing: A first-frost holiday × porcupines sewing with shed quills
